content.short: Metopia provides Web3 infrastructure that builds a data-based user reputation system for governance and rewards.
content.description: Metopia provides the infrastructure to build a data-driven user reputation system that powers governance and rewards. It aggregates contributor data from NFT collection and ownership histories, off-chain histories from Gitcoin and Discord, DAO governance activity, and credentials and identity instruments such as POAPs, SBTs, and OATs, among other signals. This unified reputation layer enables communities to evaluate contribution, credibility, and participation across both on-chain and off-chain activities.
